aictePragati.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Female Students
aictePragati.benefitAmount: ₹50,000 per annum for course fee, books, and equipment
aictePragati.reason: Exclusively designed for eligible female students pursuing technical or higher degree education with annual family income under ₹8 Lakhs.

bartiFreeCoaching.title: BARTI Free Competitive Exam Coaching and Stipend Scheme
bartiFreeCoaching.benefitAmount: Free coaching for UPSC/MPSC exams plus monthly stipend up to ₹13,000
bartiFreeCoaching.reason: Babasaheb Ambedkar Research and Training Institute (BARTI) provides specialized free coaching and financial support to SC graduate candidates in Maharashtra preparing for competitive exams.

ambedkarSwadhar.title: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Swadhar Yojana (Maharashtra)
ambedkarSwadhar.benefitAmount: Up to ₹51,000 to ₹60,000 per year for accommodation, food, and living expenses
ambedkarSwadhar.reason: This scheme supports SC students in Maharashtra who are pursuing post-matric / post-graduate courses and could not secure hostel accommodation, provided family income is under ₹2.5 Lakhs.

freeCoachingCentral.title: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students (Central Sector)
freeCoachingCentral.benefitAmount: 100% course fee covered for competitive exam coaching + stipend of ₹4,000/month
freeCoachingCentral.reason: Offered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for graduate SC students preparing for UPSC, MPSC, SSC, or Banking examinations, with income under ₹8 Lakhs.

postMatricMahaDBT.title: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (MahaDBT)
postMatricMahaDBT.benefitAmount: Full tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month
postMatricMahaDBT.reason: You are an SC category graduate student from Maharashtra with an annual family income under ₹2,50,000, making you fully eligible for higher education tuition fee coverage and stipend.

yuvaPrashikshan.title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana (Maharashtra)
yuvaPrashikshan.benefitAmount: Stipend of ₹10,000 per month during 6-month internship
yuvaPrashikshan.reason: As a 20-year-old graduate student in Maharashtra, you can get industry apprenticeship training and earn a monthly stipend to gain professional experience.

nationalFellowshipST.title: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students (NFST)
nationalFellowshipST.benefitAmount: Financial fellowship of ₹31,000 to ₹35,000 per month plus HRA and contingency grants
nationalFellowshipST.reason: Provides full financial support to meritorious ST graduate students pursuing higher research degrees (M.Phil / Ph.D.) in regular full-time courses.

overseasScholarshipST.title: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Students
overseasScholarshipST.benefitAmount: Full tuition fee, annual maintenance allowance of approx. USD 15,400, airfare, and visa fees
overseasScholarshipST.reason: Designed for ST graduate students under 35 years of age with family income under ₹6.0 Lakhs aiming to pursue Master's or Ph.D. programs abroad.

pmUspCentral.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
pmUspCentral.benefitAmount: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level and ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level
pmUspCentral.reason: Supports meritorious students from low-income families (income below ₹4.5 Lakhs) undertaking full-time college or university education.

postMatricArunachal.title: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Arunachal Pradesh)
postMatricArunachal.benefitAmount: Complete tuition fee waiver plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200
postMatricArunachal.reason: Tailored for Scheduled Tribe (ST) students from Arunachal Pradesh pursuing post-matriculation or post-graduate higher education with family annual income under ₹2.5 Lakhs.
